query_normalized: robustness of change‑point detection methods on public financial time series statistics
rationale: This paper satisfies criterion (a) and (b) because it proposes and evaluates a method for detecting distributional shifts (maximizing KL divergence between intervals) in multivariate time series, which is a direct measure of the same underlying mechanism (change-point detection) and domain (time series statistics) as the user's question, even though it uses the terminology "anomaly detection" and "divergent intervals."
